DVD-Audio MLP fixture reassembly manifest

All byte counts below refer to MLP payload bytes after the DVD-Audio Private
Stream 1 sub-header has been stripped.

aob_sectors_0_99.bin:
  sectors: 100
  mlp_packets: 100
  input_payload_bytes: 200479
  leading_fragment_bytes: 0
  complete_access_units: 704
  framed_output_bytes: 200350
  final_incomplete_carry_bytes: 129
  padding_bytes: 0
  resync_events: 0
  resync_bytes: 0
  ffmpeg_decoded_samples_from_framed_fragment: 28160

aob_sectors_48191_48210.bin:
  sectors: 20
  mlp_packets: 20
  input_payload_bytes: 40100
  first_packet_pointer: 0x0173
  first_packet_payload_start_skip: 366
  leading_fragment_bytes: 366
  complete_access_units: 80
  framed_output_bytes: 39694
  final_incomplete_carry_bytes: 40
  padding_bytes: 0
  resync_events: 0
  resync_bytes: 0
  ffmpeg_decoded_samples_from_framed_fragment: 3040

These fragments are corpus slices, not whole tracks. The Rust unit tests do not
call finish() on them because each fixture intentionally ends with a partial MLP
access unit that continues in the next sector outside the fixture window.
